# NHL® Sense Arena 26™

**Off-Ice Hockey Drills, VR Hockey Game, & NEW Mindset Training**

Step into the future of **VR hockey** with **NHL Sense Arena 26™ + DanglePro**, the **ONLY VR hockey training tool officially licensed by the NHL®**. Built for players and goalies at every level, it’s the most advanced off-ice hockey training ever built, designed to sharpen **hockey IQ, reactions, vision, hand-speed, and decision-making** .

# PLANS:
**UNLIMITED ACCESS**

 - Annual: $25/mo

 - Monthly: $59/mo

**3V3 NHL GAMES ONLY**

 - SA26 Game: $29.99 (one-time)

[media]

# NEW IN NHL SENSE ARENA 26™
- **Full-Ice Scanning in DanglePro** - Build faster hands and better awareness with new drills in DanglePro built to test your vision and hand speed.

- **Mindset Training from Pete Fry** - Prepare for games and practices with visualizations and affirmations to grow confidence and focus.

- **Play with NHL Players** – Includes rosters and collectible player profiles.



# TRAINING MODES
# 100+ VR hockey drills
- Built for both players & goalies to build hockey IQ for all skill levels and ages (10+)
- **Guided insights and drills in P.A.S. & G.A.P. training programs** for progressive development

[media]
# Game Flow for Goalies
- Build focus and stamina with uninterrupted shots from AI-assisted passes
- Three full periods of shots
- Real shooters

[media]

# DanglePro stickhandling training
- The most advanced stickhandling training
- Real puck, real space, virtual obstacles in mixed-reality
- Full-ice scanning drills added

[media]

# **Train Smarter. Play Faster. Think the Game Better. With NHL Sense Arena 26™.**
